result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but the bottom navigation bar shows clear visual defects: a stray thick black bar strikes through two of the nav icons, and the nav icons appear clipped at the bottom edge of the screen with no labels or safe-area padding.

issues.description: A thick horizontal black bar spans across the bottom navigation, running through/between the search icon and the orders (receipt) icon. It looks like a rendering artifact or a misplaced element (e.g., a broken indicator, slider, or home-gesture bar rendered in the wrong position), obscuring the nav icons.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar element; if it is the OS home indicator, ensure the nav bar accounts for it via safe-area insets so it doesn't overlap tappable icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders, profile) appear vertically clipped at the bottom edge of the screen, with the home icon and profile icon partially cut off and no visible labels or bottom padding.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding/safe-area inset to the navigation bar so all icons render fully within the visible area, and consider adding text labels for clarity and accessibility.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items have no text labels, relying solely on icons, which reduces clarity and screen-reader friendliness (especially with the icons partially obscured).
issues.suggestion: Add visible labels (e.g., Home, Search, Orders, Profile) or at minimum accessible labels for each nav item.
